approvalGate.rule: An essay at build or later cannot pass editorial validation unless outline and narrative decisions are accepted and the dated notes path resolves.

holdCriteria.condition: Outline or narrative decision is missing or blocked.
holdCriteria.releaseAction: Hold the essay below build stage; record the blocking notes and follow-up ticket.

holdCriteria.condition: A visible claim depends on an invented, inaccessible or unverified quotation, page reference, provenance statement or chronology.
holdCriteria.releaseAction: Hold the affected claim or essay; do not replace source verification with inferred precision.

holdCriteria.condition: An interactive implies measurement, registration, causality or completeness that its data cannot support.
holdCriteria.releaseAction: Hold Design QA until the interaction or its evidence boundary is corrected.

holdCriteria.condition: Keyboard, reduced-motion, text-equivalent, contrast or non-colour meaning checks regress.
holdCriteria.releaseAction: Hold publication until the automated and manual accessibility checks pass.

holdCriteria.condition: Published content, cover, social preview, section anchor or required cross-link does not resolve.
holdCriteria.releaseAction: Hold publication until the production build and indexing checks pass.

rollbackCriteria.condition: A material factual, citation, rights or provenance error is discovered after publication.
rollbackCriteria.action: Remove or correct the affected claim immediately; revert to the last known good content revision when a bounded correction cannot be verified.

rollbackCriteria.condition: A release exposes sensitive location or personal data, or creates a credible safety or privacy risk.
rollbackCriteria.action: Unpublish or redact the affected artifact first, then document the decision and verification required for restoration.

rollbackCriteria.condition: The essay route fails, the primary interactive prevents reading, or a release breaks shared navigation.
rollbackCriteria.action: Restore the last green build or remove the failing enhancement while preserving the readable essay.

recoveryRule: A held or rolled-back essay can return only after the blocking criterion has an owner, evidence of correction, an accepted review decision, and a green required-command set.
